caption: The drawing depicts a single glass goblet with a wide, shallow bowl and a short, ornate stem that sits on a circular base. The goblet features a pattern of white or light-colored, feather-like swirls and curved lines decorating the bowl, suggesting the appearance of glass or crystal with etched or painted designs. The stem is bulbous in two places, connecting the bowl to the flat, rounded foot. The background is a flat, beige color and the entire drawing uses shades of gray, black, and white to indicate shading, reflection, and highlights on the goblet’s surface. In the lower left corner, there is a small horizontal scale with evenly spaced vertical markers, drawn in black. There are no other objects or details present in the image.
title: Compote
